crossRefs.note: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be…
He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and…
By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the…
Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in…
I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says Yahweh; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it…
Tell the forest of the South, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it…
All flesh will see that I, Yahweh, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.” ’ ”

translations.web: He will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
translations.bsb: The splendor of its forests and orchards, both soul and body, it will completely destroy, as a sickness consumes a man.
translations.kjv: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.
translations.asv: And he will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and it shall be as when a standard-bearer fainteth.
